latest.title: Oil extends gains as renewed Mideast hostilities raise worries of prolonged conflict
latest.description: Oil prices rose Tuesday on worries over escalating Mideast tensions after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes over the weekend.

latest.title: Iran foreign ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz
latest.description: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

latest.title: Australia says it removed 45 crypto, remittance registrations over the past year
latest.description: AUSTRAC said its yearlong sweep included canceled, suspended and unrenewed registrations, while its action against GetCoins helped disrupt organized investment scams.

latest.title: Cholesterol drug setback casts doubt over multibillion-dollar race
latest.description: Novartis’ failure raises the stakes for Amgen and Eli Lilly in the race to turn lower Lp(a) levels into fewer heart attacks and strokes.

latest.title: Mistral bags $24 billion valuation as Samsung leads funding for Europe's AI champion
latest.description: Mistral is betting on open-weight AI models to help it compete with players like OpenAI and Anthropic.

latest.title: China's imports in August miss estimates as calls for rebalancing trade grow
latest.description: China's exports and imports gathered momentum in August, as the world's second-largest economy faces mounting pressure to rebalance trade.

latest.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest
latest.description: Supposed whitehat hackers behind Sunday’s Liquid Network breach have returned 3,400 of the 4,000 BTC they took, but nearly $47 million in bitcoin is still outstanding.

latest.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%
latest.description: Every major token fell on Tuesday, though most keep weekly gains, with traders pricing a 60% chance of a Fed hike next week.

latest.title: Global markets keep shrugging off shocks. Here's what could break that streak, according to HSBC
latest.description: Markets have shrugged off a barrage of shocks in recent years but that resilience may not last forever, according to HSBC.

latest.title: Nvidia supplier Wistron's shares drop after it announces $1.5 billion global stock sale
latest.description: Wistron shares fall Tuesday after announcement of $1.5 billion global share sale

latest.title: Liquid ‘white hats’ return $270M in Bitcoin as network prepares restart
latest.description: The actors returned 85% of the Bitcoin withdrawn from Liquid’s federation wallet following the security incident.

latest.title: Bombardier points out U.S. footprint after Trump says aerospace giant must build in America
latest.description: Trump's announcement comes on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs set to take effect Tuesday on $20 billion of U.S. goods.

latest.title: Here are the 3 big things we're watching in this holiday-shortened trading week
latest.description: The week will be dominated by inflation data. Plus, Apple's new CEO has his first big test.

latest.title: China says it will pump $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
latest.description: With a bigger capital cushion, financial institutions may also be asked to do more to mobilize resources in capital markets, analysts say.

latest.title: Metaplanet CEO breaks silence but shareholders say the hard questions remain unanswered
latest.description: Simon Gerovich said Metaplanet had not adequately explained the structure, and denied involvement in MMXX Ventures’ trading decisions.

latest.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: China's weak consumer becomes the world's problem
latest.description: A Group of 20 finance meeting in the U.S. this month has now elevated the debate over whether China's exports have cost people in other countries their jobs.

latest.title: Your LG TV Might Still Be Listening to You—Even When It Looks Like It’s Off
latest.description: A Gamers Nexus investigation found LG sets scanning every device on a home network and capturing microphone audio with the screen off, four months after LG promised Texas regulators it had cleaned up its tracking.

latest.title: Crashed Amazon cargo jet struck two vehicles, ended up 1,300 feet past runway, NTSB says
latest.description: The chair of the National Transportation Safety Board didn't provide details on the cause of the crash in Miami, which killed at least five people.
